result.summary: The page is generally well-structured and visually consistent. One minor visual inconsistency was found: the delivery-time badge on the first 'Fastest near you' card (Green Bowl Poké) uses a light/white background while the adjacent cards use dark badges, creating an inconsistent badge style within the same carousel.

issues.description: In the 'Fastest near you' carousel, the '15–25 min' badge on the Green Bowl Poké card has a light/white background with dark text, whereas the '20–30 min' badges on the neighboring cards (Smash Bros Burgers, Trattoria Piccola) use a dark background with white text. This inconsistent badge styling within the same row looks visually broken.
issues.suggestion: Unify the delivery-time badge style across all cards in the carousel (same background color, text color, and opacity) so the row appears consistent regardless of the underlying image brightness.
